what_it_is: Created Skatepark - Kingpin Skatepark - Lockport, NY
format: DexDrive .gme cut short: '123-456-STD' 3904-byte header + only the first 16384 bytes of the card (2 of 16 blocks); the card holds 1 save(s), 1 for this game (BASLUS-01066KOVYPAE)

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/psx-card.py card.mcr tony-hawks-pro-skater-2.1414.gme: unwraps the card (DexDrive .gme: 3904-byte header + card (only 16384 card bytes, zero-padded to 131072))

note: The converter pads the missing blocks with zeroes, as DuckStation's ImportCardGME does; the saves on the card all lie in the blocks present. one-saves (1saves convert) does not read this file: a PS1 memory card is 131072 bytes, or that behind a DexDrive, VGS or PSP header, but this file is 20288 bytes
